evals.name: Domain-First Feature Modularization & Layout Audit
evals.prompt: Inspect a backend repository containing top-level 'controllers/' and 'repositories/' folders and refactor it into a 4-layer domain-first structure.
evals.expected_output: Restructures files into 'src/modules/<feature>/' containing co-located controller, service, port, entity, and unit tests.
assertions: Packages code into vertical domain modules under 'src/modules/<feature>/'
Ensures unit tests are co-located alongside target services
Restricts 'src/common/' strictly to stateless cross-cutting primitives

evals.name: Pure Domain Entity Decoupling from Persistence ORM
evals.prompt: Evaluate a domain entity class containing TypeORM or Prisma annotations and decouple it into a pure domain model and infrastructure persistence mapper.
evals.expected_output: Creates a zero-dependency domain entity and a separate database repository using the Data Mapper pattern.
assertions: Removes all ORM decorators and database imports from core domain entities
Keeps domain entities as pure language classes with zero external dependencies
Encapsulates business rules and state mutations directly within the domain entity
Implements a Data Mapper in infrastructure to convert between persistence and domain models

evals.name: Dependency Inversion with Ports and Adapters
evals.prompt: Create an order cancellation use case that depends on a database repository using Dependency Inversion.
evals.expected_output: Defines an OrderRepositoryPort interface in the domain/application layer and implements a PostgresOrderRepository adapter in infrastructure.
assertions: Defines repository port interface inside the domain or application layer
Ensures application use case accepts the interface abstraction via constructor dependency injection
Implements concrete database queries exclusively inside the infrastructure adapter
Enforces inward dependency flow: Adapter -> Use Case -> Domain <- Infrastructure
